claims.evidence: No brand marking, nameplate, or logo is visible in photos 0-2.
Photo 0 shows a used mechanical assembly with a visible torque converter; the witness identifies it as a used transmission assembly.
Compatible vehicle make and model is not shown in any photo and cannot be confirmed remotely without a part number or VIN match.

risks.risk: The transmission is not tested and may not work.
risks.proof: Video of the assembly running on a bench or a shop functional test.

risks.risk: Mileage or usage history is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of service records or the donor vehicle odometer.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage or unknown wear.

risks.proof: Close-up of the manufacturing date plate or sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the oldest plausible model year for this assembly.

risks.risk: Fitment with a Ford Fusion is unproven.
risks.proof: Photo of the part number plus a compatibility listing or VIN match.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as fitment unknown; may not fit a Ford Fusion.

risks.risk: Internal damage such as worn clutches, cracked casing, or bearing failure is not visible externally.
risks.proof: Borescope video inside the casing or a pressure test.

risks.risk: Included accessories or components may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included parts such as bell housing, torque converter, mounts, and fluid.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as assembly only with no extras.

risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of a warranty document.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no warranty, sold as-is.

proof_requests: Close-up of any brand nameplate or part number.
Video of the transmission being tested or running.
Photo of the manufacturing date plate.
Photo or document showing compatibility with a Ford Fusion (part number or VIN match).
Photo of all included accessories and components.
response.reason: The witness identifies a used transmission assembly with a visible torque converter, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested used core; brand, year, mileage, and Ford Fusion fitment remain unproven.
